scope: CPU-only existing-state/provenance/gate audit; no scene or policy runs

selection.method: greedy maximin on native start-gate standardized measured state
selection.distance: sqrt(mean((feature_a-feature_b)^2)) over13 components; maximize minimum distance to previously selected starts
selection.scales: Native waffles tcp_std/gripper_std and max(q_std,radians(5)); rotvec_nearest relative to waffles mean; no joint wrapping

native_state.selection: Last native measured sample at or before reference camera start t=0 for each stream; independent sample times preserved. This file contains one initial state only, no recorded trajectory.

units.wrist_ft: recorded UR wrench units N/Nm; sensor calibration/noise uncertain
units.tcp: xyz metres + rotation vector radians, UR controller base

provenance.source_kind: native teleoperation recording start; not deployment, replay fit time, or later trajectory phase
provenance.clock: MasterClock t_master in stored ts; metadata calibration offset NOT reapplied
provenance.state_selection: First arm_q timestamp at or after all q/TCP/gripper/wrist streams begin; each other sample is causal latest at or before this anchor. q/TCP timestamp equality verified.
provenance.training_membership: Present in expanded val124. Complete expanded training manifest absent; no claim of training-unseen status.
provenance.fixed_object_transfer: Only recorded robot/gripper/wrist state transferred into canonical Aug22 packet pose; per-recording packet jitter/180-degree wrapper reversal is not reproduced.
provenance.raw_wrist_caveat: Exact measured arm_ft, including unknown gravity/tare/calibration bias; not a calibrated zero-contact wrench.
provenance.same_session_caveat: Nine starts from 135140 collection session and one from 140049; confirmation is simulator-study holdout within Aug22, not session-generalization.
